# Project Saltmarsh

Project Saltmarsh surveys how fast the salt marshes on the north shore are
eroding, and how the tidal channels move from year to year.

## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[pieter-vandam]] and runs from [[kelmouth-site]].
Elevation surveys use the [[lidar-pod-lp3]], and water readings come from
the [[drift-buoy-db9]].
